title: AuthorityInclusionManifest
description: Written to `authority/inclusion-manifest.json` in the run record, and projected (as the `authority` array) into the review projection, run-state.json, and the ACP prompt result. It is the auditable answer to "which intent was this run judged against": one entry per declared authority/context document, recording the full-content hash, the hash of EXACTLY the bytes that reached the prompt, the byte counts, and whether the inclusion was complete. Partial inclusion only ever happens through caller-declared ranges — an oversized `requireFull` document is a fail-closed halt, never a silent truncation — so `complete: false` always means the CALLER asked for less, and `embeddedHash != fullHash` proves it.

range.description: A half-open byte range [start, end) of the document.

name.description: the caller's stable label for the document (unique within a run)

source.description: `path` = read root-scoped through meshcore/scope (allowed in every mode and every judging phase). `inline` = supplied by the caller; REPORT MODE ONLY, and excluded from the host-adjudication prompt (the provenance split).

mediaType.description: advisory only; never changes how bytes are handled

fullHash.description: sha256 over the document's FULL bytes — what the caller's optional `expectedHash` pin is checked against

embeddedHash.description: sha256 over EXACTLY the bytes that reached the prompt. Equal to fullHash for a complete inclusion; different for a ranged one — so `complete` is verifiable rather than merely asserted.

complete.description: whether the whole document was embedded

ranges.description: the caller-declared byte ranges, present only for an incomplete (ranges) inclusion
